adminMessage.title: Admin Message
adminMessage.description: Internal error detail for admins. Not shown to user.

answerCaptureTemplate.title: Answer Capture Template
answerCaptureTemplate.description: Legacy internal answer capture template. Do not display directly; currentQuestion owns the Enhanced Chat renderer.

answersJson.title: Answers JSON
answersJson.description: Updated answers JSON to carry forward to next action.

consentMessage.title: Consent Message
consentMessage.description: Message to display when consent is required before proceeding.

currentQuestion.title: Current Question Contract
currentQuestion.description: Structured question contract for the SmartIntakeQuestionLTI custom renderer. This is the only displayable question UI payload.

errorType.title: Error Type
errorType.description: Type of error that occurred if success is false.

intakeSessionId.title: Intake Session Id
intakeSessionId.description: Session ID to store and pass to every subsequent action.

isComplete.title: Is Complete
isComplete.description: True when all questions are answered. Triggers save flow.

primaryRecordId.title: Primary Record Id
primaryRecordId.description: Salesforce record ID after save. Not used by this action.

progressJson.title: Progress JSON
progressJson.description: Progress data for UI progress bar rendering.

questionJson.title: Question JSON
questionJson.description: Full question details including text, type, options. Pass to LWC.

requiresConsent.title: Requires Consent
requiresConsent.description: True if user must accept consent before proceeding.

requiresFinalConfirmation.title: Requires Final Confirmation
requiresFinalConfirmation.description: True when all answers collected and confirmation needed.

success.title: Success
success.description: False if an error occurred. Check before proceeding.

templateKey.title: Template Key
templateKey.description: Echo of the template key used.

userMessage.title: User Message
userMessage.description: Message to display to the user. Always show this when present.
